{"hypotheses":[{"nl":"Recolor every nonzero cell to 2 and append the top max(1, half-height rounded down) rows.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x!=0 else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+a[:max(1,len(a)//2)]"},{"nl":"Recolor nonzeros to 2 and append enough initial rows to make height floor(3h/2), with at least one row.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+[a[i%len(a)] for i in range(max(1,len(a)//2))]"},{"nl":"Map all occupied cells to 2; duplicate the first row and then the central three rows for height six.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+([a[0]] if len(a)==3 else a[2:5])"},{"nl":"Replace nonzero values by 2, and append rows selected by a 3-row repeating extension rule.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; k=max(1,len(a)//2); return a+a[:k] if len(a)<=3 else a+a[2:5]"},{"nl":"Recolor foreground to 2 and append the prefix whose length is the smaller of one and half the height.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x!=0 else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; k=1 if len(a)<=3 else len(a)//2; return a+a[:k]"},{"nl":"Convert all nonzero cells to 2; for heights 3 and 6 append respectively row 1 and rows 3-5.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x!=0 else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+([a[0]] if len(a)==3 else a[2:5])"},{"nl":"Change every occupied cell to 2 and extend with the first h//2 rows, treating odd h as one appended row.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+a[:(len(a)//2 or 1)]"},{"nl":"Recolor to 2 and append a contiguous block of rows occupying half the original height, rounded down but never zero.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+a[:max(1,len(a)//2)]"},{"nl":"All nonzero cells become 2; append the first row for a 3-row input and rows 3 through 5 for a 6-row input.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+([a[0]] if len(a)==3 else a[2:5])"},{"nl":"Recolor foreground and append the central half when even, otherwise the leading singleton row.","code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+(a[2:5] if len(a)==6 else a[:1])"}]}

foils.nl: Map all occupied cells to 2; duplicate the first row and then the central three rows for height six.
foils.code:
def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+([a[0]] if len(a)==3 else a[2:5])

foils.nl: Replace nonzero values by 2, and append rows selected by a 3-row repeating extension rule.
foils.code:
def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; k=max(1,len(a)//2); return a+a[:k] if len(a)<=3 else a+a[2:5]

foils.nl: Recolor foreground and append the central half when even, otherwise the leading singleton row.
foils.code:
def transform(grid):
 a=[[2 if x else 0 for x in r] for r in grid]; return a+(a[2:5] if len(a)==6 else a[:1])
